ai_summary: Kwai's on-device vision stack: a custom ycnnnet v3/v4 inference runtime in libykit.so (CPU/OpenCL, TFLite and SNPE/MTK-APU shims) drives camera face detection/landmarks (libfacedetectcontext.so), the FaceMagic beauty/effect engine (libFaceMagic.so + libskwai.so), and the KVE video-analysis engine (libvisionengine.so, Halide). The APK contains no model weights: 102 KSModel*.model names and model families are compiled into libykit.so, but the actual model files and the voice-detection TFLite model (voice_detect_mode.tflite) are downloaded per resource key from config-driven CDN URLs into <cache>/magic_effect_resource/<resourceKey>/ (or <cache>/.magic_model/magic_model/<resourceKey>/) and validated against check.json MD5 lists. JAX reimplementation is therefore ARCHITECTURE_ONLY with recovered I/O contracts.

features.name: Camera face detection and landmarks (YCNN)
pipeline: NV21/NV12 camera frame -> VideoRawFrameFromJni -> kuaishou::model::FaceData
FaceDetectorContext.setData(type, modelPath) supplies the ycnn detector model path at runtime
libfacedetectcontext.so -> virtual SetData(int,std::string), then ycnn detector via libykit.so (CPU NEON or OpenCL)
detectFacesFromFrame returns protobuf FaceData[] (rect, landmark points, score) to Java
models: downloaded magic_ycnn_model_* resource (face detect / landmark, KSModelLandmark01..15 family)
features.notes: Wiring and JNI names confirmed; the exact KSModel file used per model_type is inside stripped YCNNGetConfig2Model and remains inferred.

features.name: FaceMagic camera beauty / makeup / 3D / segmentation effects
pipeline: FaceMagicController.nativeSetExternalBuiltinPath / nativeSetBeautifyExternalBuiltinPath point at the downloaded effect resource dir
AE2 Resource exposes ycnnModelPath / ycnnModelPathMap / dirtyLensProcessorModelPath / mmuModelPath to libFaceMagic.so
FMBeautifyEffectInterface::setBeautifyExternalModelPath and FMEffectAsyncProcessor::setSkinColorDetectModelPath load auxiliary models
GL/CGE/skwai renders warp, smoothing, makeup, and Face/Body/Cloth/Hair/Hand/Ground/Depth segmentation masks
models: ycnn models inside each downloaded MagicFace effect package (magic_ycnn_model_*, bg_model.bin, fg_model.bin)
features.notes: Exported JNI and rodata strings confirm model-path handoff; the internal layout of an effect package is not observable statically.

features.name: YCNN plugin analyses (salient region, face attributes, general recognition)
pipeline: Westeros plugin frame stream -> ycnn model (libykit) -> protobuf results
SalientData / YcnnFaceAttributeResult parseFrom(byte[]) callbacks to Java
model directory supplied via JSON param attr_local_path
features.notes: Java JNI surface and result protobufs confirmed; plugin implementation lives in dynamically loaded westeros/ve plugins, so per-call model selection is inferred from resource keys.

features.name: KVE smart edit / smart cover / gallery / upload analysis
pipeline: Video/image assets -> libvisionengine.so Halide pipelines
features: kSharpness, kColorfulness, kLowLight, kJunk, kNoTexture, kSceneChange, kSceneClass, kSaliencyPortion, kHumanVoice, face metrics (kFaceNumber/kFaceSharpness/kEyeOpenness/kFaceSmile...)
scene classification + salient/face score DAGs (face_score_dag, face_laplacian_dag, compute_saliency_area)
ranking/selection for smart edit, cover, duplicate removal
models: none bundled; voice stage uses downloaded voice_detect_mode.tflite
features.notes: Feature enum and JNI names confirmed from libvisionengine.so; individual formula weights/thresholds are compiled Halide code.

features.name: AI edit GAN and MMU avatar models (memoji/animoji/face blend)
pipeline: effect package supplies aiedit.pbs.AIEditParamGan model_path / model_dir / landmark_model_path
MMU avatar resources magic_mmu_model_* downloaded through the same MagicModel resource path
libykit_module.so / libykit.so run the GAN or avatar model; output composited by FaceMagic/CGE
models: magic_mmu_model_animoji1, magic_mmu_model_basewhite, magic_mmu_model_ear, magic_mmu_model_faceblend, magic_mmu_model_faceprop, magic_mmu_model_memoji
features.notes: JNI entrypoints and protobuf field names confirmed; mapping of each effect to a specific model bundle is not statically observable.

features.name: Editor voice detection (TFLite)
pipeline: resource key voice_detect_mode -> config response field voice_detect_mode_v1
download + unzip to <magic root>/voice_detect_mode/ -> check.json MD5 validation
model path passed to editor KVE native voice detector backed by libtensorflow-lite.so
features.notes: Model name, resource route, and path handoff confirmed; the file itself and its tensor signature are unavailable.

models.path: remote:KSModel*.model registry in lib/arm64-v8a/libykit.so (102 names, 19 cfg families)
models.format: ycnnnet v3/v4 binary or JSON model (.model + *_cfg.txt)

io.input: NV21/NV12/grey/rgb/bgr float image planes; net_w, net_h, inputMeanVals from per-model config
io.output: typed outputs: face rect+landmarks, matting alpha, segmentation masks, human pose, scene class, generic blobs

models.verification: no model bytes in APK; carve_models.py found no TFLite/zip/caffe container in any AI lib
no .tflite member in APK; TFL3 magic appears only as the TFLite schema string in libtensorflow-lite.so at 0x2f7c25

reimplementation.limitations: No weights or per-model graph exist in the APK; all ycnn model files are downloaded resources. Detector graph, landmark semantics and preprocessing means are model-specific and unavailable. Implemented stages: NV21/NV12->RGB (BT.601 limited), crop/resize/mean preprocessing, ycnn-style heatmap+landmark detector with deterministic random init, and KVE feature statistics. Numeric parity cannot be claimed.

data_pipelines.name: Camera frame -> YCNN face detect -> FaceData protobuf -> Java
data_pipelines.applies_to: com.kwai.bulldog (native identical to kwai_video; Java VideoFrame class absent here)

trigger.kind: camera frame callback / explicit detect call
trigger.native: Java_com_kwai_camerasdk_face_FaceDetectorContext_nativeDetectFacesFromFrame @ libfacedetectcontext.so 0x1a19c (1312 B); detect is the C++ virtual [ctx iface vtable+0x68] at 0x1a24c
trigger.lifecycle: nativeInit 0x184b0 -> nativeSetData 0x18e28 -> nativePrepare 0x1af34 -> per-frame detect -> nativeDestroy 0x18b10

transport.frame_types: YUV=1, TEXTURE=2, RGBA=3, BITMAP=4 (VideoFrame constants); None=0
transport.native_dispatch: type 1 -> FrameBuffer bytes, MediaDataType 35; type 3 -> bytes, MediaDataType 38; type 4 -> Bitmap ctor; type 2 -> GL texture ctor (libdaenerys.so 0xececc-0xed0a0)
transport.format: NV21/NV12/I420-family CPU planes or OES/2D GL texture; yuv_format int carried in VideoFrame
transport.dimensions: VideoFrame.width/height (raw); effective size = crop_*_frac of Transform, rotated, rounded to multiple of 4 (VideoFrame.transformedWidth/Height)
transport.rotation: kuaishou.model.VideoFrameAttributes.transform.rotation (+mirror, crop fracs); detector also uses kuaishou::SensorManager::GetOrientation90 (libdaenerys.so exports, libfacedetectcontext.so imports)

preprocessing: ycnn::YCNNCropDataMatrix crop+convert; ycnn accepts only grey/nv21/nv12 or rgb/bgr/*-norm/yuv0 (libykit.so rodata 0x83af40/0x83ad59)
per-model inputMeanVals subtraction and net_w/net_h resize from the downloaded model config
rotate/flipHor applied from YCNNModelIn (or detector config) before inference

model_invocation.engine: ycnnnet v3/v4 in libykit.so (CPU NEON / OpenCL; TFLite + SNPE shims)
model_invocation.binding: KSJNILib.renderModel(Object,byte[]) @ 0xc8360 reads KSRenderObj.mKSJNIRenderObj(J), mModelIn fields colorType/rotate/flipHor/width/height/frame_time/single_image/normOut/normRotate/normFlipHor/normFlipVer; pixels = byte[] arg
model_invocation.cadence: KSLandmarksParam defaults maxFaceNum=4, minFaceSize=50, detectIntervals=5, detectMode=4 (SuperFast), useImageTrack=2 (TRACK_128)
model_invocation.model_path: downloaded resource dir, handed in by FaceDetectorContext.setData(type,path); gated by vendor flag com.kwai.camerasdk.videoCapture.cameras.camera2.vendor.a.f23915h

postprocessing: FaceData::SerializeToString per face (libfacedetectcontext.so 0x1a6f8) -> NewByteArray JNI#176 (env+0x580, 0x1a71c) -> SetByteArrayRegion JNI#208 (env+0x680, 0x1a75c) -> SetObjectArrayElement JNI#174 (env+0x570, 0x1a390) into the array created by NewObjectArray JNI#172 (env+0x560, 0x1a30c)

kuaishou.model.FaceData wire: 1 float, 2 float, 3 float confidence, 4 rect, 5 pose(yaw,pitch,roll), 6 landmark(points/bytes/extra/flipped), 7 original_rect, 8 gender enum (libdaenerys.so serializer 0x179520)
consumer: application code: FaceData list drives overlays/effects; the only DEX method descriptor in this APK that mentions Lcom/kwai/camerasdk/video/VideoFrame; is com.kwai.video.ksmedialivekit.LivePushClient$1.onVideoFrame (classes8.dex)
threading: detector runs on the calling thread under Java lock
async init supported (FaceDetectInitType Auto/Sync/Async; BaseFaceDetector is_async_init + Runloop, libfacedetectcontext.so rodata 0x2408a/0x23fb8)
failure_fallback: setData is a no-op when vendor flag f23915h is false -> detector stays without a model
missing model file: '[YcnnFaceDetector] Ycnn model missing %s' (libfacedetectcontext.so 0x244be) -> onModelMissingCallback(int,String) 0x249fd -> Java ModelMissingListener.onModelMissing
model bytes are read through Java com.kwai.camerasdk.utils.ResourceLoader.loadData(String,boolean)[B (rodata 0x239a9/0x23ac4); file://asset/ accepted (0x243bd)

data_pipelines.name: Camera/player frame -> FMGlProcessor ycnn detect -> FM::FMFaceData -> FaceMagic GL render -> encoder

transport.thread: GL render thread; async effect worker FM::FMEffectAsyncProcessor (libFaceMagic.so 0x384d9)

threading: callbacks to Java: onCallCaptureTexture, expression/portrait/bokeh/body-slimming listeners
